blocks.text: INN NEWS - there's a joke from the late 4th President of RI Abdulrraman Wahid aka Guspur who is very famous in Papua. He has no fear of anything but Papuans' prayers!
This particular joke of Gushdur actually has a very deep meaning in these days.
Papuans' voices and prayers 2014 and 2019 came to take Joko Widodo (Jokowi) to hang out two periods of being president. Papuans love Jokowi and it's hard to move on.

But it turns out that this time the Papuans' voices and prayers were not immediately directed towards Gibran who went forward as a vice president of Prabowo Subianto. The love for Jokowi doesn't make Papuans blind and just keep Jokowi upright.
For the President's choice, Papuans don't vote that easily to Gibran who is notabene the son of Jokowi.
The main reason the people of Papua don't want to vote for Prabowo-Gibran is a factor of Prabowo's past crimes that are difficult to forgive and accept Papuans.
In this election, the Papuans are actually quite difficult to determine. Mr. Ganjar is personally attractive to the Papuan people, and is tied to the issue of the U20 world cup.
Papuans were injured because of the rejection of the U- 20 world cup that presented Timnas Israel.

The AMIN couple (Anies- Muhaimin) obviously not, because since 2014-2019 Anies has never been noticed in Papua. But what's very surprising is that the Papuans' voices and prayers for President 2024 have recently been heard.

Ganjar received it on the island of Mansiman is a sign that Papuans' voices and prayers have been heard. Mansiman is the most influential island in Papua because on the island the gospel first entered.
What's quite surprising is that Mr. Jokowi has yet to set foot on the island. Even more exciting is the fact that Prabowo was rejected there by the leaders of Mansinam Island.

The reason the island leader of Mansiman accepted Ganjar sir is a trace record of how Mr. Ganjar raised Papuan students there studied in Java during covid. More than that the leaders and people of Mansinam Island believe in spiritual signs.

The message of King Saul and David became the messages of the Jews who made it so that they opened the door to Ganjar sir. As validation of data, writers directly engaged the communication process with the Mansiman leader both before and when Ganjar came to Mansinam.
The media and society who can join as a source or witness how the story of Ganjar sir's journey to Mansinam has no engineering, let alone political gimmick with the help of the sembaku.
I know the character of Mansinam's leader who was very straight and could even say no to Ganjar before. But after praying he gave a different response.

He finally accepted even to pray for Ganjar sir. The Mansiman Island Society was even moved to wag-royong prepare for welcome. To me it's a sign that Papuans' voices and prayers for President 2024 have been heard.
For people who don't understand the Gusdus Tweet will think this is nonsense.
Let's see, Guddu's wave will eventually come true that Papuans' voices and prayers are not random!
